signals.re_read_files.push(file.to_string());\n200\t        }\n201\t    }\n202\t    signals.re_read_files.sort();\n203\t\n204\t    // Multi-edit files: files written/edited more than once\n205\t    for (file, count) in &file_writes_edits {\n206\t        if *count > 1 {\n207\t            signals.multi_edit_files.push(file.to_string());\n208\t        }\n209\t    }\n210\t    signals.multi_edit_files.sort();\n211\t\n212\t    // Config files\n213\t    signals.read_config_files = config_reads;\n214\t    signals.modified_config_files = config_modifies;\n215\t    signals.config_writes = config_writes;\n216\t\n217\t    // Duration\n218\t    let first_ts = events.first().map(|e| e.ts).unwrap();\n219\t    let last_ts = events.last().map(|e| e.ts).unwrap();\n220\t    signals.duration_secs = (last_ts - first_ts).num_seconds().unsigned_abs();\n221\t\n222\t    // Assistant turn ratio\n223\t    if total_turns > 0 {\n224\t        signals.assistant_turn_ratio = assistant_turns as f32 / total_turns as f32;\n225\t    }\n226\t\n227\t    signals\n228\t}\n229\t\n230\t/// Extract a file_path from a tool_call event's tool_params.\n231\tfn .and_then(|v| v.as_str())\n237\t}\n238\t\n239\t/// Check if a file path matches any config/memory file pattern.\n240\tfn is_config_file(path: &str, patterns: &[&str]) -> bool {\n241\t    let        // Also check if the path contains the pattern as a directory component\n251\t        if path_normalized.contains(pattern) && pattern.starts_with('.') {\n252\t            return true;\n253\t        }\n254\t        // Check for memory/*.md pattern\n255\t        if (*pattern == \"memory/\" || *pattern == \"docs/notes/\") && path_normalized.contains(pattern)\n256\t        {\n257\t false\n268\t}\n269\t\n270\t/// Write behavioral signals to a sidecar JSON file.\n271\t///\n272\t/// The sidecar is stored as `sessions/<agent>/<session_id>.behavioral.json`\n273\t/// alongside the Arguments\n317\t///\n318\t/// * `session_id` - Session identifier string (format: \"agent/session-id\")\n319\t///\n320\t/// # Returns\n321\t///\n322\t/// * `Ok(BehavioralSignals)` - Successfully parsed signals\n323\t/// * `Ok(BehavioralSignals::default())` - Sidecar file doesn't exist yet\n324\t/// * `Err` - File exists but cannot be read or parsed\n325\t///\n326\t/// # Examples\n327\t///\n328\t/// ```ignore\n329\t/// use agentscribe::enrichment::behavioral_signals::read_behavioral_signals;\n330\t///\n331\t/// let signals = Result<BehavioralSignals> {\n335\t    // Get the data directory from environment or default\n336\t    let data_dir = std::env::var(\"AGENTSCRIBE_DATA_DIR\")\n337\t        .map(std::path::PathBuf::from)\n338\t        .unwrap_or_else(|_| {\n339\t            let home = directories::BaseDirs::new()\n340\t                .expect(\"Failed to determine home data_dir.join(\"sessions\");\n347\t    let parts: Vec<&str> = session_id.splitn(2, '/').collect();\n348\t    if parts.len() != 2 {\n349\t        anyhow::bail!(\n350\t            \"Invalid session_id format: expected 'agent/session-id', got: {}\",\n351\t            session_id\n352\t        );\n353\t    }\n354\t\n355\t    let sidecar_path = session_dir\n356\t        .join(parts[0])\n357\t        .join(format!(\"{}.behavioral.json\", parts[1]));\n358\t\n359\t    // Return empty default if file doesn't exist\n360\t    if !sidecar_path.exists() {\n361\t        return Ok(BehavioralSignals::default());\n362\t    }\n363\t\n364\t    // Read and parse the file\n365\t    let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&sidecar_path).map_err(|e| {\n366\t        anyhow::anyhow!(\n367\t            \"Failed to read behavioral signals file {:?}: {}\",\n368\t            sidecar_path,\n369\t            e\n370\t        )\n371\t    })?;\n372\t\n373\t    serde_json::from_str(&content).map_err(|e| {\n374\t        anyhow::anyhow!(\n375\t            \"Failed to parse behavioral signals JSON from {:?}: {}\",\n376\t            sidecar_path,\n377\t            e\n378\t        )\n379\t    })\n380\t}\n381\t\n382\t/// Detect a working directory change from a Bash tool_call event.\n383\t///\n384\t/// Looks for `cd <dir>` commands in the Bash tool's params.\n385\tfn detect_cwd_change(event: &Event) -> Option<String> {\n386\t    event\n387\t        .tool_params\n388\t        .as_ref()\n389\t        .and_then(|p| p.get(\"command\"))\n390\t        .and_then(|v| v.as_str())\n391\t        .and_then(|cmd| {\n392\t            // Simple cd detection: command starts with \"cd \" or contains \" && cd \" etc.\n393\t            let trimmed =     if !dir.is_empty() && dir != \"-\" {\n398\t                    return Some(dir.to_string());\n399\t                }\n400\t            }\n401\t            None\n402\t        })\n403\t}\n404\t\n405\t#[cfg(test)]\n406\tmod tests {\n407\t    use super::*;\n408\t    use crate::event::Event;\n409\t    use chrono::Utc;\n410\t    use serde_json::json;\n411\t\n412\t    fn This format enables:\n23\t//! - Unified search across all agent types\n24\t//! - Agent-agnostic analytics and enrichment\n25\t//! - Simple, diff-friendly storage (append-only JSONL)\n26\t//!\n27\t//! # Data Flow\n28\t//!\n29\t//! 1. **Scraping**: Agent-specific log formats are read from their native locations\n30\t//! 2. **Normalization**: Events are converted to the canonical format via field mapping and event expansion\n31\t//! 3. **Storage**: Normalized events are written as JSONL to `sessions/<agent>/<session-id>.jsonl`\n32\t//! 4. **Enrichment**: Events are analyzed to extract outcomes, solutions, errors, and patterns\n33\t//! 5. **Indexing**: Session metadata and content are indexed in Tantivy for fast search\n34\t//!\n35\t//! # Examples\n36\t//!\n37\t//! ```no_run\n38\t//! use agentscribe::event::{Event, Role};\n39\t//! use chrono::Utc;\n40\t//!\n41\t//! // Create a new event (typically done by parsers, not users)\n42\t//! let event = Event::new(\n43\t//!
